name: Expanded Ritual Spells
body:
Learn new ways to use your spells in rituals.

Prerequisite(s): Ritual spells class feature, can cast 4th-level spells.

Benefit(s): Choose a 4th-level spell you know and up to one of each higher level you know. You may now cast those spells as ritual spells along with their normal use.

Special: When you gain access to a new level of spells, you may add one spell of that level to this list.
